description_ru: Юноша впервые готовит ужин для друзей, а бабушка подсказывает ему рецепт по телефону.
text:
Omar: Hello, Grandma? It is Omar. Are you busy?
Fatima: Hello, my dear boy! No, I am not busy. I am watching a little television. How are you?
Omar: I am fine, but I have a problem. Tomorrow my friends come to my flat for dinner, and I want to cook rice with chicken. Your rice with chicken!
Fatima: Ah, my special dish! That is wonderful. But you never cook, Omar. Remember the eggs last month?
Omar: Please, Grandma, don't remind me. This time I do it well. Can you teach me on the phone?
Fatima: Of course. Go to the kitchen and take a pen. We start with the shopping list.

Fatima: You need one kilo of chicken, two cups of rice, three onions, some tomatoes, garlic and a lot of spices.
Omar: Wait, wait, I write it down. One kilo of chicken, two cups of rice. What spices?
Fatima: Salt, black pepper and a little yellow powder called turmeric. It makes the rice golden and beautiful.
Omar: Tur-me-ric. Okay. I buy everything at the market tomorrow morning.
Fatima: Good. Buy fresh chicken, not frozen. And call me again when you are ready to cook.
Omar: I promise. Thank you, Grandma. I love you.

Omar: Grandma, I am in the kitchen now. I have the chicken, the rice, the onions and the spices. What do I do first?
Fatima: First wash your hands. Then cut the onions in small pieces. Don't cry!
Omar: Too late, my eyes are already wet. Ow! Okay, the onions are ready.
Fatima: Now put some oil in a big pot. Wait until it is hot, and then add the onions. Stir them until they are brown.
Omar: It smells good already. What next?
Fatima: Add the chicken and the spices. Stir for ten minutes, and then add the tomatoes.

Omar: Grandma, there is a problem. The chicken is sticking to the pot, and there is smoke!
Fatima: Turn down the fire, quickly! And add a little water. Not too much.
Omar: Okay. The smoke is going away. Phew. That is better.
Fatima: You see, a good cook is calm. Now wash the rice in a bowl until the water is clear.
Omar: It takes a long time. Why do I need to wash it?
Fatima: Because clean rice is fluffy, not sticky. Then put it in the pot with two cups of water and close the lid. Don't open it for twenty minutes.

Omar: Grandma, while the chicken cooks, tell me. Where do you learn this recipe?
Fatima: From my own grandmother, in a small village by the sea. We cook on a wood fire, and the whole house smells of spices.
Omar: Do you miss that place?
Fatima: Every day. But when you cook my recipe, the village comes back to me. That makes me happy.
Omar: Then I promise to cook it often, and one day to take you there.

Omar: Twenty minutes is a long time. My friends arrive in half an hour! Grandma, are you still there?
Fatima: Yes, my dear. While you wait, set the table and put some flowers in a glass. A beautiful table makes the food taste better.
Omar: I have no flowers, but I have a green plant.
Fatima: That is fine. Put it in the middle. And light a candle if you have one.
Omar: I do. Oh, the doorbell is ringing. My friends are early!
Fatima: Open the lid and look. If the water is gone, the rice is ready.

Omar: The rice is perfect! It is golden, and it smells wonderful. Grandma, I did it!
Fatima: I am so proud of you. Now put the chicken on top and bring it to the table. Good luck, my dear.
Friend: Omar, what is that smell? It is amazing!
Omar: It is my grandmother's recipe. Please sit down, everybody. Dinner is ready.
Friend: This is the best rice I ever eat. Who cooks it?
Omar: I do, with a little help from a very special person.

Omar: Hello, Grandma. Everybody loves the dinner. My friends want to learn your recipe.
Fatima: That makes me so happy. Why don't you all come here on Sunday? I teach all of you.
Omar: Really? We love to come. I bring the dessert.
Fatima: No, no, you only bring yourselves. And Omar, no more eggs, please.
Omar: No more eggs, I promise. Thank you for everything, Grandma. I love you.
Fatima: I love you too, my dear. Sleep well.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Долгий звук между «э» и «ё», губы не округляйте; в американском варианте добавляется «r».
Короткий звук, похожий на «а», рот открыт не широко; не заменяйте на «о».
Скольжение от «э» к «у» с округлением губ; не заменяйте на чистое «о».
Звонкие согласные в конце слова не оглушайте: «d» в «old» не должно звучать как «т».

questions.question: What does Omar want to cook?
What problem happens with the chicken?
questions.answer: It sticks to the pot and there is smoke.

questions.question: What do the friends think of the dinner?
